## Main tutorial

### Quick-to-run example

A **simple use-case** that grafts missing taxa on a toy backbone phylogeny is available in the README of the package, and a **full workflow from the data to the checked grafted phylogenies** is presented in the [main workflow tutorial](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/main_workflow.html): `vignette("main_workflow")`.

For more advanced uses, please refer to the tutorials below.


## Which tutorial do I need?

| I want to... | Tutorial |
|:---|:---|
| Format my data into a `missing_taxa_list` (tables, node IDs, MRCA tips) | [`format_inputs`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/format_inputs.html): `vignette("format_inputs")` |
| Build stochastic maps (simmaps) of species attributes from tip data | `prepare_trait_data` *(in preparation)* |
| See a full analysis, from tip data to checked grafted phylogenies | [`main_workflow`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/main_workflow.html): `vignette("main_workflow")` |
| Graft missing taxa within target clades, and tune the options | `graft_taxa` *(in preparation)* |
| Graft missing clades as sisters of clades of the backbone | `graft_clades` *(in preparation)* |
| Graft both types of missing lineages in one run | `combine_missing_taxa_and_clades` *(in preparation)* |
| Check the grafting plan before, and the grafted phylogenies after | `check_grafting` *(in preparation)* |
| Constrain grafting with biogeographic ranges | `biogeographic_data` *(in preparation)* |
| Constrain grafting with several traits | `multiple_traits` *(in preparation)* |
| Constrain grafting with a continuous trait | `continuous_data` *(in preparation)* |
| Account for uncertainty: several simulations, several maps | `handle_uncertainty` *(in preparation)* |
| Speed up grafting with parallel computation | `parallel_grafting` *(in preparation)* |
| Resume a crashed or interrupted run | `resume_crashed_run` *(in preparation)* |


## Advanced uses / tutorials

The following tutorials present the **usages** of phylograftR in detail.
They provide explanations on available arguments and interpretations of results across multiple types of data.
Tutorials *in preparation* become links, with their `vignette()` call, once they are available.

### **1/ Inputs**

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; [1.1/ Format __inputs__ prior to grafting](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/format_inputs.html): `vignette("format_inputs")`.

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; 1.2/ Prepare __trait data__ and build stochastic maps with deepSTRAPP: `prepare_trait_data` *(in preparation)*.

### **2/ Classic workflow (from scratch)**

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; [Full __grafting workflow__](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/main_workflow.html), from a phylogeny and tip data to the checked grafted phylogenies: `vignette("main_workflow")`.

### **3/ Grafting options**

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; 3.1/ Graft __missing taxa__ within target clades: `graft_taxa` *(in preparation)*.

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; 3.2/ Graft __missing clades__ as sisters of clades of the backbone: `graft_clades` *(in preparation)*.

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; 3.3/ Graft __both types__ of missing lineages: `combine_missing_taxa_and_clades` *(in preparation)*.

### **4/ Checks**

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; Check the __grafting plan__ and the __grafted phylogenies__, and extract information: `check_grafting` *(in preparation)*.

### **5/ Data types**

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; 5.1/ __Biogeographic__ range data: `biogeographic_data` *(in preparation)*.

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; 5.2/ __Multiple traits__: `multiple_traits` *(in preparation)*.

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; 5.3/ __Continuous__ trait data: `continuous_data` *(in preparation)*.

### **6/ Uncertainty and scaling**

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; 6.1/ Handle __uncertainty__ with several simulations and stochastic maps: `handle_uncertainty` *(in preparation)*.

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; 6.2/ Run grafting in __parallel__: `parallel_grafting` *(in preparation)*.

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp; 6.3/ __Resume__ a crashed or interrupted run: `resume_crashed_run` *(in preparation)*.
